notes.title: 1.5.5 FIXED!
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where wrong 1.5.5 build was uploaded!

We're sorry for any trouble this caused. We've created a "stable" branch for situations such as this, to ensure content is always accessible even when there's errors in new releases.

notes.title: 1.5.4 Patch Notes - The Time Has Come
notes.content:
Several fixes and minor improvements, including:

- Fixed a major bug where Time Badges were unobtainable.
- You can toggle windowed mode from the settings now!
- Fixed a couple minor bugs and UI issues.
- Feedback button now directs you to places where I'll actually see the feedback.
